title: Fresh device: Claim now works with empty storage
actual: Card: 'Today's gift is claimed. Days claimed: 1. Gift claimed. 36 shards were added to your Realm purse.' Button shows 'Claimed today'. Wording is clear. (Shards still a Realm currency the player has not met, but the text now says 'Realm purse'.)

title: One first move: PLAY 'Start the guided adventure' and Next line 'the guided adventure (Realm)' agree
expected: One call to action leading into the guided Realm
actual: PLAY sub-line reads 'Start the guided adventure', the Next line reads 'Next: the guided adventure (Realm)'; tapping PLAY opens games/mad-maze/index.html?mode=world&from=hub directly (no Town join form). Remaining nit: the Map view's 'Things you could do' still suggests 'Make a first friend - Isles' on a fresh profile (a different first move on the Map).

title: Back pill now reads 'Home'; Menu compass still absent on the join card
expected: Back pill says Home; compass Menu top-left
actual: Pill reads '<- Home' (FIXED) and the third wording is still there: button '↩️ Continue: Home'. #mm-nav-btn is still absent on the join card (partly NOT FIXED, P3). Footer still lists WASD/E/B/1-9/P keys.

title: Event countdown gone and a bag is now pointed at, but a passive new player still dies on the Shore in about 35 s
steps: Empty storage, phone, Home > PLAY, tap Thicket Ranger
Move with WASD briefly, hold Space (fire) for ~10 s, then stand mostly still while the coach says step 3/4
expected: First minute on 'Shore - Safe-ish' is survivable while reading coach cards
actual: FIXED parts: no 'Raid in' / 'Swarm in' banner for 50 s; coach step 3 now says 'A bag is close by, to your right'; the fall panel is a proper card with 'Try again' and 'Leave' (see next item). NOT FIXED: HP fell from 94 (6 s) to 46 (16 s) to 0 (35 s) with enemy shots and a crab around the spawn; the player had 1 kill. Input here was keyboard on a touch viewport, so a real player with two sticks may fare better; frequency counted 'once' in round 1, 'once' now (2 of 2 passive runs died before step 5).

title: Fall panel is readable with Try again and Leave, coach card no longer overlays it
steps: Die on the Shore during the coach
expected: Readable fall card with a visible Try again
actual: Card: Zone, Kills, Shards this run, Survivor's cache, 'Try again' (large) and 'Leave'. The coach card is hidden behind/after it.

title: Map default node now offers 'Play' instead of 'Coming soon'
steps: Phone, Home, tap Map, tap Open
actual: Card 'PIXELTOWN SQUARE / Not visited yet' has an enabled 'Play' button. Names still differ from Home cards (Hearthvale, The Lantern, Lakeside Angler, Hearthvale Isles) and the HUD name is still 'VILLAGER' (P3 nit).

title: Town offline HUD unchanged: 'Where to?' top-right at (260,62), 12 counters, A / C buttons 50x50, quick-emote bar mid-screen, 'Hold to talk' shown offline
steps: Phone, DB blocked + firebase SDK stub, name + avatar, Join, Play offline
expected: Menu top-left, primary buttons >= 56 px, <= 3 HUD numbers, no walkie while offline
actual: Same as round 1: #interact-btn and #mobile-chat-btn 50x50, 'Where to?' at 260,62, #mm-nav-btn absent, 'Hold to talk' visible, big counter panel, emote strip over the play field.

title: Stack Tower end card now has a MENU button; intro has no key names
steps: Stack Tower > Got it, Play, miss until it falls
actual: Buttons: PLAY AGAIN, REPLAY SEED, MENU, plus Share code COPY. Intro text (~55 words) no longer names keys.

title: Isles and Pixel Pop still show keyboard keys to a phone player; Town join footer still lists WASD/E/B/1-9/P; Realm skip link still reads 'WASD move, Space fire, Esc menu'
steps: Phone, open Isles, Pixel Pop, Town join card
expected: No key names on a coarse pointer
actual: Regex for WASD|arrows|Enter or Space|Space or click matches Isles and Pop body text; Town join footer unchanged; Realm DOM text 'Play: focus the game (WASD move, Space fire, Esc menu)'. Stack and Lantern are clean.

title: Home still shows 13 places and a footer of '<- Town', 'Daily gift', 'Map', 'Open'; Lantern still has its own NEW HERO form
steps: Phone, Home, read grid and footer; open Lantern
actual: Unchanged: footer duplicates PLAY with '<- Town' and has 'Open'; Lantern page shows 'Create a hero first ... NEW HERO' form.

title: With only the DB blocked, 'Play offline' appears ~6.5 s after clicking Join; Join stays disabled with no reason until a name is typed
steps: Phone, DB blocked (no SDK stub), join card, type name, pick avatar, Join
expected: Short wait, 'Type a name first' hint
actual: Offline offer after 6.5 s (round 1: ~10 s, so shorter) with text 'Can't reach the town server. Check your connection, or play offline.' Disabled Join still has no hint text. 12 blocked DB attempts were recorded and all aborted by blockDb.

title: Realm phone HUD still shows compass + hamburger + Leave + Daily + gear between the thumbs
expected: One Menu top-left; nothing between the thumbs
actual: Compass top-left, hamburger and Leave top-right, 'Daily' above the left stick, gear at the bottom between sticks. Unchanged.
